packageRules.description: Major bumps of embedded actions release the workflow as a minor (feat), keeping the -vN alias promise honest — DEV-494. If a major is genuinely breaking for the workflow's interface, escalate the PR title to feat! by hand.

default.json sets semanticCommitType=fix at the top level, but it also extends config:recommended, which sets semanticCommitType per-package inside packageRules — package rules apply after top-level config, so config:recommended's per-package setting wins and non-major action bumps land titled chore(deps) instead of fix(deps) (DEV-1312, DEV-1309). release-please only cuts a version bump on feat/fix commits, so a chore(deps) squash-merges to main without releasing, and the bumped action never reaches a repo still pinned to the moving <workflow>-vN alias. Scoped to minor/patch/pin/digest only (matching the update types default.json's own grouping rule uses) so this cannot match major updates and clobber the DEV-494 rule above — majors must keep resolving to feat regardless of array order.
